detail: Seeded a log with a root, two children that refine it, and a grandchild under child A, then started a real server. The map list shows root > [child-a, child-b], and grand sits under child-a, not directly under root.

With the map open, the CLI ran 'add append-log --title "Use an append-only log" --parent root' and 'accept append-log --actor you'. The tile appeared under root as real within 5 s. A window flag set before the CLI calls was still there, so the page did not reload. No click was made.

Clicking the child-a tile set the URL to #child-a. The detail showed h1 'Child A' and its body. The page had no input, textarea, select, contenteditable, textbox or button. After page.reload() the same card opened, and #child-a was still in the URL.

A second 'werk serve --port 0' started in the same project. It printed 'werk: waiting for pid <first pid> to let go of the lock'. It exited with code 1 after about 5.3 s and printed 'another werk is already serving this repository on port N (pid <first pid>)'. Then the first server's map loaded again with the same 4 cards.

Ran .werk-heldout/e2e-a/s69-5.sh. It git-clones the checkout to a temp directory and runs 'make e2e' there. The run exited 0 with a pass or fail line for each of 25 tests. The e2e/harness.ts code boots a real 'werk serve' on a copy of e2e/fixture-project. The run left 25 evidence.png files under test-results, one per test. The clone has no .werk/log.jsonl before or after the run, git status is clean, and the fixture is unchanged.

Seeded the real card Payments. The CLI ran 'add refunds --title Refunds --parent payments' (agent actor). On the map, refunds is nested under payments, with a dashed border-top and the colour rgb(138,138,138). The Payments tile is neither dashed nor grey.

Opened the ghost Refunds from the map and pressed the 'Accept #refunds' ✓ button. The log grew by exactly 1 line: {type: node.accepted, actor: you, payload.id: refunds}. The card view then had no ✓ button. Back on the map, refunds sits under payments with data-proposed=false and no dashed border.

Seeded real Payments, the ghost Refunds under it, and the ghost Partial refunds under Refunds. Opened Partial refunds and pressed ✓. On the map, Partial refunds and Refunds are both data-proposed=false and not dashed. The nesting payments > refunds > partial is kept.

Seeded ghosts Refunds and Chargebacks under Payments. Refunds has a ghost option (alternative_to) and a ghost source (supported_by). The map view has 0 buttons, and the Refunds card view has exactly 1 accept button. After ✓, the map shows refunds, its option and its source as real. Chargebacks is still dashed and grey, and the map has no button.
Opened two pages on the server. Both showed refunds as a ghost. Pressed ✓ on Refunds in page 1. Page 2, with no action, redrew refunds as data-proposed=false and not dashed within 5 s.

Seeded decided A, B and C, with B depends_on A and C depends_on B. Ran 'werk reopen a --reason rejected --why ...' and then opened the map. B shows a 'stale' mark with background rgb(179,38,30). B keeps data-status=decided and the green border-left rgb(46,125,50). C has no mark element, so it shows neither stale nor paused.

Same chain, reopened A with --reason postponed. B and C each show a 'paused' mark with background rgb(117,117,117), and neither has a stale mark. C keeps data-status=decided and the green border-left.

Seeded A and B, with B depends_on A, and reopened A with the reason rejected and 'The vendor dropped this API'. Opened B. The marks region has h2 'Why this card is stale' and text '#a Card A ... was reopened, rejected ... along depends_on'. It also shows the sentence 'The vendor dropped this API'.

A <- B <- C by depends_on, and A reopened postponed with 'We build the engine next quarter'. Opened C. The marks region names '#a Card A', 'was reopened, postponed' and the sentence. The step needs the heading 'Why this card is stale', but the h2 reads 'Why this card is paused paused'.

Seeded A, X and B, with B depends_on both. Reopened X postponed, then A rejected. B shows exactly one mark: 'stale', red rgb(179,38,30), and no paused mark. B's card view has a trace with data-cause=a and data-reason=rejected that names '#a Card A' and 'rejected'.
